title: Graduation, Regents diplomas and college and career readiness
source: NYC Department of Education (NYC Public Schools), Graduation Results, school level (Cohorts 2012-2021); 4-year CCR score from the 2024-25 School Quality Report, High School results
vintage: Cohort 2021 (Class of 2025), 4-year August; 6-year rate Cohort 2019; CCR from 2024-25 School Quality Report

grad_4yr.label: 4-year graduation rate (Class of 2025)
grad_4yr.definition: Share of the Cohort 2021 (students who first entered 9th grade in 2021-22) who earned a Local or Regents diploma within four years, including August graduates.
grad_4yr.source_field: '% Grads' (sheet 'All', Category = 'All Students', Cohort Year = 2021, Cohort = '4 year August')

cohort_4yr.label: 4-year cohort size
cohort_4yr.definition: Number of students in the school's Cohort 2021 graduation cohort.
cohort_4yr.source_field: '# Total Cohort' (sheet 'All', Category = 'All Students', Cohort Year = 2021, Cohort = '4 year August')

regents_4yr.label: Regents diploma rate (4-year)
regents_4yr.definition: Share of the 4-year cohort who earned a Regents diploma (with or without Advanced designation).
regents_4yr.source_field: '% Total Regents of Cohort' (sheet 'All', Category = 'All Students', Cohort Year = 2021, Cohort = '4 year August')

adv_regents_4yr.label: Advanced Regents diploma rate (4-year)
adv_regents_4yr.definition: Share of the 4-year cohort who earned a Regents diploma with Advanced designation.
adv_regents_4yr.source_field: '% Advanced Regents of Cohort' (sheet 'All', Category = 'All Students', Cohort Year = 2021, Cohort = '4 year August')

dropout_4yr.label: Dropout rate (4-year)
dropout_4yr.definition: Share of the 4-year cohort recorded as dropouts as of August of the fourth year.
dropout_4yr.source_field: '% Dropout' (sheet 'All', Category = 'All Students', Cohort Year = 2021, Cohort = '4 year August')

grad_6yr.label: 6-year graduation rate (Cohort 2019)
grad_6yr.definition: Share of the Cohort 2019 (entered 9th grade in 2019-20) who earned a Local or Regents diploma within six years, including August graduates. This is an older cohort than the 4-year rate.
grad_6yr.source_field: '% Grads' (sheet 'All', Category = 'All Students', Cohort Year = 2019, Cohort = '6 year August')

cohort_6yr.label: 6-year cohort size
cohort_6yr.definition: Number of students in the school's Cohort 2019 graduation cohort.
cohort_6yr.source_field: '# Total Cohort' (sheet 'All', Category = 'All Students', Cohort Year = 2019, Cohort = '6 year August')

transfer_grad.label: Transfer-school graduation rate
transfer_grad.definition: DOE's alternative graduation rate for transfer high schools: share of the transfer school's graduation cohort (students whose transfer-school graduation deadline, end of year six or seven of high school, fell in 2025, plus earlier-deadline students who graduated in 2025) who earned a Regents or Local diploma. Not comparable to the 4-year rate.
transfer_grad.source_field: '% Grads' (sheet 'Transfer Schools', Category = 'All Students', Cohort Year = 2019)

transfer_cohort.label: Transfer-school cohort size
transfer_cohort.definition: Number of students in the transfer school's graduation cohort.
transfer_cohort.source_field: '# Total Cohort' (sheet 'Transfer Schools', Category = 'All Students', Cohort Year = 2019)

ccr_4yr.label: College and career readiness score (4-year, 0-100)
ccr_4yr.definition: Average College and Career Readiness (CCR) score of students in the school's four-year cohort (Class of 2025) after their fourth year. Each student scores 0-100 based on course grades, test scores, advanced courses and endorsements. This is an average score, not the percent of students who are ready.
ccr_4yr.source_field: 'Metric Value - 4-Year College and Career Readiness - All Students' (2024-25 HS School Quality Report, sheet 'Instruction and Performance')

ccr_4yr_n.label: Students in CCR cohort
ccr_4yr_n.definition: Number of students contributing to the 4-year CCR score.
ccr_4yr_n.source_field: 'N count - 4-Year College and Career Readiness - All Students' (2024-25 HS School Quality Report, sheet 'Instruction and Performance')

notes: Citywide reference (citywide graduation file, All Students): 4-year August rate 81.2% for Cohort 2021; 6-year August rate 87.5% for Cohort 2019. Citywide cohorts include out-of-district placements, so they do not sum from school rows.

Graduation file: '2025-graduation-rates-public-school.xlsx' from https://infohub.nyced.org/reports/academics/graduation-results. Latest 4-year cohort is Cohort 2021 (Class of 2025); latest 6-year August cohort is Cohort 2019 (Class of 2023, measured by August 2025).

Graduation file coverage: school-level results are Districts 1-32 only. Charter schools are not on the 'All' tab, so charters have no grad_4yr/grad_6yr (InfoHub says a separate charter graduation report 'will be posted shortly'; it was not posted as of 2026-10-07). District 75 and District 79 schools have no school rows.
Graduation suppression marker: 's' (rows with fewer than 5 students, plus complementary suppression). Stored as null.

Transfer schools: 57 DBNs on the 'Transfer Schools' tab for Cohort Year 2019; 49 of them also have a regular 4-year row on the 'All' tab, and 8 are charter transfer schools (the only charter rows in this file). DOE publishes the transfer rate because transfer schools enroll over-age, under-credited students; for those schools transfer_grad is the fairer measure.
Transfer tab suppresses cohorts of 10 or fewer students (to align with the School Quality Report); its percentages are rounded in the source (e.g. 73, 73.3).
regents_4yr includes Advanced Regents. Graduates = Regents + Local diplomas.

CCR source: 2024-25 High School School Quality Report (data/sources/nyc_doe_sqr_hs_2024-25.xlsx = https://infohub.nyced.org/docs/default-source/default-document-library/202425-hs-sqr-results.xlsx, landing page https://infohub.nyced.org/reports/students-and-schools/school-quality/school-quality-reports-and-resources/school-quality-reports-citywide-results). The SQR attributes students to the last diploma-granting school as of June 30 of year four, so its cohorts differ slightly from the graduation file's.
CCR suppression marker: 'N<15' (value) with blank N count. Stored as null. Charter high schools appear in the SQR file but have no CCR value.
The 2024-25 Educator Guide notes CCR replaced the College Readiness Index (reported 2012-2020) and was introduced in the 2023-24 reports.
Percent columns are 0-100 in the source; stored as decimals rounded to 4 places. ccr_4yr stays on its native 0-100 scale.

Raw graduation school file is 56 MB and is not committed. The build script downloads it from file_url and caches it at /var/folders/50/ct9y6k7s19l4swcw8vf7xprw0000gn/T/nyc-schools-atlas-sources/2025-graduation-rates-public-school.xlsx.
